member.name: M:Microsoft.Agents.Storage.Transcript.PathUtils.NormalizePath(System.String)
member.summary: Normalizes authored path to OS-compatible path.
member.remarks: Path is from authored content which doesn't know what OS it is running on. This method treats / and \ both as separators regardless of OS, for Windows that means changing all `/` characters to `/`, and for Linux/Mac `\` to `/`. This allows author to use ../foo.lg or ..\foo.lg as equivalents for importing.
member.param: authoredPath.
